Value of the custom field. The data type of the value passed in corresponds with the data_type of the Custom Field Definition.

x-changelog.description: Adds the "currency_configuration.currency_iso_code" string field
Adds the "reviewed_at" date-time string field

The attachment logic has been reworked. Previously, the request body accepted `prostore_file_ids`. Now you must provide one of the following argument arrays, depending on your type of upload object: `upload_ids`, `drawing_revision_ids`, `file_version_ids`, `form_ids`, or `image_ids`.
Added the "external_data" object to the extended view response payload. This object contains the following fields: - origin_id: string - origin_code: string - origin_data: string
Add "currency_configuration.base_currency_iso_code" and "currency_configuration.currency_exchange_rate" string fields

x-changelog.summary: Support attaching files from change events
x-changelog.description:
A new request parameter `change_event_attachment_ids` supports attaching
files which are presently attached to change events.
Adds "enable_ssov" boolean parameter to enable SSOV on a Commitment Change Order

x-changelog.summary: Support attaching files from request for quotes
x-changelog.description:
A new request parameter `request_for_quote_attachment_ids` supports attaching
files which are presently attached to request for quotes (or their quotes / responses).

patch.description: Update the specified Commitment Change Order. This endpoint currently only supports projects using 1 and 2 tier change order configurations.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: run_configurable_validations
parameters.description: If true, validations are run for the corresponding Configurable Field Set.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies Which view (which attributes) of the resource is going to be present in the response. the extended view includes change events data, while the default view does not.

batch_id.description: Unique identifier for a change order batch.

change_order_change_reason_id.description: Unique identifier for the change reason.

designated_reviewer_id.description: Unique identifier for the designated reviewer. This field is only supported for single-tier projects. Behavior is undefined in multi-tier projects.

received_from_id.description: Unique identifier for the received from entity.

signature_required.description: Whether a signature will be required for this Change Order

executed.description: Whether or not the Change Order is executed

private.description: Whether or not the Commitment Change Order is private

paid.description: Whether or not the Commitment Change Order is paid

reason.description: Reason for the change order

custom_field_%{custom_field_definition_i.description:
Value of the custom field. The data type of the value passed in corresponds with the data_type of the Custom Field Definition.
For a lov_entry data_type the value passed in should be the ID of one of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries. For a lov_entries data_type the value passed in should be an array of IDs of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries.

enable_ssov.description: Whether to enable SSOV on this Change Order. Only applicable to Commitment Change Orders.

revised_substantial_completion_date.description: Revised substantial completion date, only supported for Prime Change Orders on single-tier projects.

change_event_attachment_ids.description: List of attachment IDs to attach. These must presently be associated with Change Events.

request_for_quote_attachment_ids.description: List of attachment IDs to attach. These must presently be associated with Request For Quotes (or their Quotes / Responses).

attachment_ids.description: Existing attachments to preserve on the response

drawing_revision_ids.description: Drawing Revisions to attach to the response

file_version_ids.description: File Versions to attach to the response

form_ids.description: Forms to attach to the response

image_ids.description: Images to attach to the response

upload_ids.description: Uploads to attach to the response

x-changelog.description: Adds the "currency_configuration.currency_iso_code" string field
Adds the "reviewed_at" date-time string field

x-changelog.summary: Move change_events field to the extended view
x-changelog.description: The change_events field is now included only when the extended view of the resource is requested by passing view=extended as a query parameter.

The attachment logic has been reworked. Previously, the request body accepted `prostore_file_ids`. Now you must provide one of the following argument arrays, depending on your type of upload object: `upload_ids`, `drawing_revision_ids`, `file_version_ids`, `form_ids`, or `image_ids`. To preserve any pre-existing attachments, you must provide their IDs in the `attachment_ids` array.
Added the "external_data" object to the extended view response payload. This object contains the following fields: - origin_id: string - origin_code: string - origin_data: string
Add "currency_configuration.base_currency_iso_code" and "currency_configuration.currency_exchange_rate" string fields

x-changelog.summary: Restrict legacy_request_id parameter to three-tier projects only
x-changelog.description: The legacy_request_id parameter is now restricted to three-tier change order projects only.

x-changelog.summary: Support attaching files from change events
x-changelog.description:
A new request parameter `change_event_attachment_ids` supports attaching
files which are presently attached to change events.
Adds "enable_ssov" boolean parameter to enable or disable SSOV on a Commitment Change Order

x-changelog.summary: Support attaching files from request for quotes
x-changelog.description:
A new request parameter `request_for_quote_attachment_ids` supports attaching
files which are presently attached to request for quotes (or their quotes / responses).
